text_block_list.text:
Hm, it's you! Hehehe, yesterday was super 
fun~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I watched a movie where the main 
character was a villain! That guy was 
running completely wild and doing whatever 
he wanted!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Swinging weapons all around! Beating 
heroes of justice to a pulp! Blowing away 
anyone I don't like!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That movie was super refreshing! 
Windy-chan is gonna go wild too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy made the most of her break 
and seems completely refreshed!
